## Third-Party Code

This directory contains external reference code snapshots kept separate from the
main SAGE implementation.

- `NaPO-master/`: original extracted directory from the public NaPO repository
  (`https://github.com/zhangzef/NaPO`).

These directories are not part of the core SAGE contribution. Keep upstream
notices intact, and do not assume a repository-level license unless one is
present in the referenced upstream project.
